home.hero_subtitle: AI-powered disaster coordination platform for a resilient India. Real-time. Everywhere. Always.
home.mission_text: ResQ AI was built on a single belief: in the chaos of disaster, the right information delivered at the right time saves lives. We combine satellite data, AI prediction, and human networks to create India's most responsive emergency coordination platform.
home.feature_1_desc: Live data from USGS, IMD, NASA FIRMS - refreshed every 5 minutes.
home.feature_2_desc: One tap sends GPS location to NDRF and nearby volunteers instantly.
home.feature_3_desc: XGBoost flood prediction overlays with confidence intervals.
home.feature_4_desc: Reports queue without internet, then sync cleanly on reconnect.
home.feature_5_desc: Verified first responders dispatched within 5km using PostGIS.
home.feature_6_desc: Live incident management, resource allocation, and alert routing.
home.lifecycle_step1_desc: One-tap SOS with auto GPS location capture.
home.lifecycle_step2_desc: Severity classification and resource allocation AI.
home.lifecycle_step3_desc: Command center confirms and escalates the incident.
home.lifecycle_step4_desc: Nearest volunteers dispatched via PostGIS spatial query.
home.lifecycle_step5_desc: Incident closed, data logged, community notified.
